prompts.logo: Create a production-ready app logo mark for Owlio, a friendly Windows voice dictation app with a cute owl mascot. Asset: one standalone owl symbol, square composition, genuinely transparent background. Flat vector-like brand illustration with clean smooth geometric curves and a strong recognizable silhouette. Cute rounded owl with small ear tufts, large expressive cream eyes, dark cocoa pupils and tiny warm peach beak. Use a restrained warm plum/cocoa, ivory and apricot palette matching a calm cream desktop interface. Make the owl compact and beautifully balanced, with subtle rounded wings and a friendly confident expression. Design must remain recognizable as a 16px Windows taskbar icon: bold shapes, few details, no fine feathers or tiny accessories. Owl occupies approximately 88% of square image, centered with safe margins. No letters, no wordmark, no tile or background plate, no microphone prop, no shadow, no gradient, no 3D, no mockup, no watermark. High-resolution clean edges and true alpha transparency.
prompts.taskbar: Create a small-size Windows taskbar logo for the Owlio voice dictation app, using the supplied owl as the brand reference. Preserve its friendly character and warm plum, ivory and apricot colors, but redesign as ONLY a simplified owl HEAD symbol: two modest ear tufts, one rounded plum silhouette, a joined ivory face mask, two large round dark eyes with ONE clean white highlight each, and one small apricot triangle beak. No body, no wings, no feet, no eyebrows, no tiny textures or fine lines. Make a professional flat-vector-style icon, filled solid colors without gradients or shadows. Its two eyes and ear tufts must read clearly at 16x16 pixels. Square composition with head occupying approximately 88% width, centered, balanced, and generous safe margin at the corners. Genuinely transparent background, no lettering, no wordmark, no enclosing tile or badge, no mockup. Deliver ONE icon, high-resolution with crisp clean edges.
